universities.name: Mother Teresa Women's University
universities.summary: Mother Teresa Women’s University is a Tamil Nadu state university established in 1984 at Kodaikanal. Its regular postgraduate departments cover science, commerce, humanities, social sciences and communication. The current admission notice invites women candidates and distinguishes Kodaikanal programmes from those at Madurai and Chennai research and extension centres.
universities.campusLifestyle: Regular Kodaikanal study combines departmental classes with the practical, project or fieldwork requirements of each degree. The university lists libraries, scientific facilities, sports and yoga, student services and hostels. Confirm which Kodaikanal location hosts the selected department and its daily timetable before arranging housing; the university also operates separately listed extension centres.
universities.cityProfile: Kodaikanal is the university’s home city in Dindigul district, Tamil Nadu. The current regular-admission notice gives the Registrar’s address at the Attuvampatty campus and identifies Madurai and Chennai centres separately. Plan travel and housing around the actual department, class timetable and any practical attendance; a programme available at an extension centre is not automatically interchangeable with Kodaikanal.
universities.practicalExposure: The named curricula include subject-specific practical, project and research study. Laboratory sciences require experimental work; communication degrees include media practice; Social Work has field-based learning; Home Science programmes include nutrition or textile-related practical study. Ask the department about supervision, assessment, facilities and any off-campus attendance. These academic programmes do not promise employment or confer a regulated professional registration by admission alone.
universities.hostelOverview: The university publishes hostel facilities at Attuvampatty and Anandagiri, with separate hostel contacts. The current web page lists registration, development and establishment charges plus a monthly mess bill; it does not label those web amounts with the2026–27 academic year. Request the current room allocation, fee invoice and residence rules before budgeting. Admission to a degree does not reserve a hostel place.
universities.dietarySupport: The hostel page lists a separate monthly mess bill. Confirm the current menu, meal timings, dietary or allergy arrangements and payment rules directly with the hostel. Do not assume a particular meal plan, cuisine or dietary accommodation from academic admission alone.
universities.safetyOverview: Obtain the current anti-ragging, grievance and residence procedures at admission. Confirm departmental reporting and supervision arrangements for laboratory work, fieldwork or off-campus activities. Plan daily travel around the allocated campus and timetable.
universities.studentSupport: The university lists library services, student portals, hostel contacts and academic departments. Use the admissions office for qualification equivalence and selection questions, and the department for practical or project requirements. Confirm scholarship, disability support and accommodation conditions individually.

faq.question: How long are the regular PG degrees?
faq.answer: The degrees included here are two-year regular postgraduate programmes, normally structured across four consecutive semesters under their named regulations.

faq.answer: No. Science, nutrition, textiles and commerce degrees specify relevant prior study. Some humanities, communication and social-work regulations accept any recognised undergraduate degree, subject to university assessment.
